### MyFitnessPal {#review-app-4}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      3 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 22 авг. 2026 г. - 9 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _CyndySmith_, 9 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "I signed up and paid £16, then tried to do meal planning and I need to pay another £20/month. Seriously?"
            2. _Leemiz_, 22 авг. 2026 г., 1/5: "Every three clicks on the app prompts it asking me to buy premium. No. I don’t want it and clicking so all the time is very very annoying"
            3. _timbaa88_, 1 сент. 2026 г., 5/5: "I accidentally purchased the one-year subscription instead of the monthly option. Unfortunately, I only noticed my mistake when I checked the charge on my online banking account, less than 24 hours after making the purchase. I contacted customer support immediately and requested a refund so that I could repurchase the subscription using the monthly option instead. Unfortunately, my refund request was denied. I’m disappointed because this was a genuine mistake, reported very quickly, and I wasn’t asking to cancel my subscription altogether—I simply wanted the opportunity to switch to the monthly plan. I feel that a little more flexibility and understanding from customer support would have made a big difference. I don’t want to rate the app itself based on a bad experience caused by my own mistake, as I understand that I selected the wrong subscription option. However, considering I noticed the mistake and requested a refund in less than 24 hours, I feel they could have honoured the refund and allowed me to repurchase the monthly subscription instead."
<!--/ir-theme-->
